import json,numpy as np,sys
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot
CAM='robot0_eye_in_hand'
r=Robot(); D=json.load(open('/app/output/calibration.json'))
J=np.array([[*(np.array(d['dp'])/(d['q1'][d['i']]-d['q0'][d['i']])),*(np.array(d['dr'])/(d['q1'][d['i']]-d['q0'][d['i']]))] for d in D]).T

def state(o):
 p=o.meta['proprio']['now'];T=np.array(o.meta['cameras'][CAM]['cam2world_gl']);return np.array(p[26:29]),T[:3,:3],np.array(p[4:11])
def command(q,grip=-1,n=16,note=''):
 a=np.zeros((n,13));a[:,:7]=q;a[:,7]=grip;a[:,12]=-1
 return r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=[CAM],video='none',include_depth=True,note=note)
def servo(target, Rdes, grip=-1, max_iter=20, prefix='stage'):
 global J
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=[CAM],video='none',include_depth=True)
 trace=[]
 for k in range(max_iter):
  p,R,q=state(o);e=np.r_[target-p, Rotation.from_matrix(Rdes@R.T).as_rotvec()]
  print(k,'p',p.round(4),'err',e.round(4),'q',q.round(3),flush=True)
  if np.linalg.norm(e[:3])<.008 and np.linalg.norm(e[3:])<.035:break
  W=np.diag([1,1,1,.25,.25,.25]);A=W@J;b=W@e
  dq=A.T@np.linalg.solve(A@A.T + 0.0001*np.eye(6),b)
  md=np.max(np.abs(dq));
  if md>.12:dq*=.12/md
  o1=command(q+dq,grip=grip,n=16,note=prefix+':servo')
  p1,R1,q1=state(o1);dqa=q1-q;dx=np.r_[p1-p,Rotation.from_matrix(R1@R.T).as_rotvec()]
  J+=np.outer(dx-J@dqa,dqa)/(dqa@dqa+1e-8)
  trace.append({'p':p.tolist(),'q':q.tolist(),'dq':dqa.tolist(),'err':e.tolist()})
  o=o1
 o.save('/app/output/'+prefix)
 Path('/app/output/'+prefix+'_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,indent=2))
 return o
if __name__=='__main__':
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=[CAM],video='none');p,R,q=state(o)
 target=np.array([float(x) for x in sys.argv[1:4]])
 servo(target,R,prefix=sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv)>4 else 'stage')
